evidence: Plaut. Merc. 168: Hercle vērō vāpulābis, nisi jam loquere aut hinc abīs.
terms.comment: The future of vāpulō, be beaten: active in form, passive in sense.

phrases.latin: Hercle vērō vāpulābis, nisi jam loquere aut hinc abīs.
phrases.english: By Hercules, you really will catch it, unless you speak up this minute or get out of here.

phrases.latin: nunc, quandō ego sum, vāpulābis, nī hinc abīs, ignōbilis
phrases.english: now, since that is who I am, you’ll get a beating unless you clear off, you nobody
